<!-- pr-reviewer: 579b110ae33f2b68c1559c40f56729e27a7a2750 -->
**Needs a merge with main - not built.**

Thanks @austin62jake. The branch conflicts with current `main` in one file, so I did not build or run the suites.

**Conflict: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` (module list, around line 83)**
- This PR adds `mod gcode_viewer;`.
- `main` added `mod first_setup;` on the same line (from the "a new document reaches the Setups page" fix).
- Resolution is keep-both: leave both `mod` lines. Please run `git merge origin/main`, keep both, re-run the quick gate, and push (plain push, no force).

**Read-through of the diff (not built, so not verified by running)**
- `pages.rs` `gcode_listing`: the row is now a left-to-right box of `width` x `row_h` with `truncate()`. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`, and no new index math. This stays in the ui layer, so layering is fine. It looks right.
- The new test file starts with a provenance header. The only `panic!` is in the test helper, which is allowed.
- The decision record is in `docs/decisions/256-gcode-left-align.md`, not `RECOMMENDED.md`, as the process asks.
- The PR body has a `Changelog:` line and `Refs #256`. That is correct since colouring is left open. Note that `Refs` means the issue will not close on merge.
- `pages.rs` is 1843 lines, already far over 400. The growth is small (+13), so this is not blocking.
- The 3 pixel-snapshot failures you report match the known clean-`main` platform artifact (#255).

I will re-review once the merge is pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d773dbf2c1dfd51bf442666d4df2450603da0178 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thanks @austin62jake - the merge with main is clean and the fix does what it says.

**What looks good**
- `pages.rs` `gcode_listing` (~1232-1251): each row is a left-to-right box of `width` x `row_h` with `truncate()`. Row height is unchanged, so the scroll-cursor arithmetic still holds. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`, no new indexing; ui layer only.
- Two pinning tests through the real shell layout, reading painted text shapes (a good choice over the accessibility rect). New test file has a provenance header.
- Decision record is in `docs/decisions/256-gcode-left-align.md`, not `RECOMMENDED.md`. Body has `Changelog:` and `Refs #256` (correct, colouring stays open); no `CHANGELOG.md` edit in the PR.

**Local results (PR head trial-merged with current main, Windows, own target dir)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-ui --lib` | 318 pass, 0 fail, 2 ignored (includes both new `gcode_viewer` tests) |
| `boundary` / `boundary_picks` / `theme_files` | 3 / 6 / 14 pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| UI pixel snapshots | not run (the viewer is closed in every snapshot; known platform artifact #255) |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `pages.rs` is far over 400 lines (growth here is small, +13).
- Because this is `Refs #256`, the issue stays open for the syntax-colouring ask.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
